description: This source file contains integration tests for loan chargeback scenarios with credit allocations in the Apache Fineract project. The tests cover various cases such as simple chargebacks, chargebacks on specific days, reverse replay with backdated payments, and accounting-related chargeback handling, including overpayment scenarios. The class extends a base test class and uses JUnit 5 for test definitions. It also involves multiple external models, helpers, and the use of Lombok for logging.

classes.name: LoanChargebackWithCreditAllocationsIntegrationTests
classes.description: Integration test class for testing loan chargeback scenarios with credit allocations. Extends BaseLoanIntegrationTest and includes multiple test cases covering different chargeback and repayment scenarios.

methods.name: simpleChargebackWithCreditAllocationPenaltyFeeInterestAndPrincipal
methods.description: Tests a simple chargeback scenario with credit allocation for penalty, fee, interest, and principal. Includes loan creation, disbursement, charges, repayments, chargebacks, and multiple verification steps.

methods.name: simpleChargebackWithCreditAllocationPenaltyFeeInterestAndPrincipalOnTheLastDayOfTheInstallment
methods.description: Tests chargeback happening on the last day of an installment, with verification of schedule and transactions.

methods.name: simpleChargebackWithCreditAllocationPenaltyFeeInterestAndPrincipalOnTheLastDayOfTheLoan
methods.description: Tests chargeback on the last day of the loan, ensuring correct repayment schedule and transaction tracking.

methods.name: chargebackWithCreditAllocationPenaltyFeeInterestAndPrincipalOnNPlusOneInstallment
methods.description: Chargeback after multiple installments, simulating a scenario where the chargeback occurs on the (N+1)th installment.

methods.name: chargebackWithCreditAllocationReverseReplayedWithBackdatedPayment
methods.description: Tests reverse replay with backdated payment, involving chargeback and re-synchronization of the schedule.

methods.name: chargebackWithCreditAllocationAndReverseReplayWithBackdatedPayment
methods.description: Tests chargeback with credit allocations and a backdated payment that triggers reverse replay.

methods.name: chargebackWithCreditAllocationPrincipalInterestFeePenalty
methods.description: Tests chargeback involving principal, interest, fee, and penalty, verifying proper handling of combined charges.

methods.name: testAccountingChargebackOnPrincipal
methods.description: Verifies accounting entries for chargeback on principal alone, including GL journal entry validation.

methods.name: testAccountingChargebackOnPrincipalAndFees
methods.description: Assesses accounting entries when chargeback applies to principal and fees, checking debit and credit journal entries.

methods.name: testAccountingChargebackOnPrincipalAndPenalties
methods.description: Checks accounting entries for chargeback involving principal and penalties, including journal validation.

methods.name: testAccountingOverpaymentAmountIsSmallerThanChargeback
methods.description: Verifies handling of overpayment scenarios where chargeback amount exceeds paid amount, and the resulting transactions.

methods.name: chargebackWithCreditAllocationPrincipalInterestFeePenaltyWhenOverpaidDefaultPaymentPrincipalFirst
methods.description: Tests chargeback with credit allocation priority on principal first, with overpayment handling.

methods.name: doubleChargebackWithCreditAllocationPenaltyFeeInterestAndPrincipal
methods.description: Simulates double chargeback scenario with penalty, fee, interest, and principal, verifying correct schedule and transactions.

methods.name: chargebackWithCreditAllocationReverseReplayedOnlyPenaltyPayedWithCreditAllocationPenaltyFeeInterestAndPrincipal
methods.description: A complex case with reversing replay where only penalty was paid, testing proper rollback.

methods.name: doubleChargebackReverseReplayedBothFeeAndPenaltyPayedWithCreditAllocationPenaltyFeeInterestAndPrincipal
methods.description: Tests reversal replay for both fee and penalty chargebacks with credit allocations, ensuring schedule consistency.
